$comment: Age signals, ADR 0229 (bipe/docs/adr): the age comes from the OS, never from a date of birth. The apps read Apple Declared Age Range (iOS, with appleGates) or Google Play Age Signals (Android Play build) and send the range to PUT /v1/me/age. The server maps the range to one band with ageBand() in tools/lib/registries.mjs and stores only the band. Rule: the band that holds the lowest age the range allows (lower, or 0 when lower is absent). No range is unknown. bands: in order, youngest first, each from min to max inclusive; the first has no min and the last no max. adultBand: the only band that does not get the under-18 defaults (unknown gets them too). recheckDays: the app reads the OS signal again when the server's age_checked_at is older than this. sources: where a range came from; none means the OS gave nothing (declined, no signal, foss build).
